note: Recorded text-mode conversation (Nebius-hosted stand-in LLM, same prompt and tools as the Bolna agent). Replayed tool calls run through the live engine.

turns.text: Hello Kamla, this is Ruko, Demo Bank's automated payment safety assistant. This call is recorded for your safety. Your code word is ANAR 21. Does it match your app?
Yes, that's my code word. But there is a CBI officer on the other phone, he says I must move my money to a safe account, please help me.

args.evidence: CBI officer on the other phone says I must move money

turns.text: There's no 'digital arrest' in Indian law; it's a fraud. Police, CBI or courts never arrest or question anyone on a video call. Did the person say they were from the police, CBI, customs or a court, or ask you to stay on a video call?
Yes, he said he was CBI and told me to stay on the video call. Oh, thank God, please stop the payment and call my son Ravi.

args.evidence: CBI officer on video call directing me

turns.text: Would you like me to call Ravi, your son, so you can talk it over before any money moves?
Yes, please call Ravi right away. I don't want to pay anything now.

args.reason: Multiple warning signs: fake CBI officer, video call direction, secrecy. Trusted contact being called.

turns.text: I've asked Ravi to be called now. The money stays in your account until you've talked.
